issuer: the General Traffic Department (الإدارة العامة للمرور) and its traffic offices
note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshot of 19 April 2010 (the last good one; the first is of 6 July 2007, with the same words) of the Ministry of Interior's own guide to traffic transactions, 'رخص القيادة' (moi.gov.ye, under the Police Services Sector, General Traffic Department; the site gives this egress no answer today). It quotes art. 23(1) of the Traffic Law and says an applicant must be at least 18, 'with regard to the other age groups of the other licences set by the law'; applications go to the traffic department, licences for Arabs and foreigners are granted by the General Traffic Department; the licence fee was 2,000 rials (with a 100-rial form, a medical examination and a 50-rial levy). The snapshot is of 2010 (the archive's next capture, of November 2011, is an error page), and no later Ministry text was found, so the age is the 2010 page's and no proof the rule still holds; the fee is null, since a 2010 amount is no proof of today's, and the term isn't stated.
